thread:
sara_cs: quick debrief after Ternion cutover — want to capture outstanding network / IAM / KMS / audit items and any renewal risks. Can the ops folks confirm status? :wave:

mike_cloudops: thanks. from infra side: VPC peering + routes validated. saw one missing route to analytics-subnet; added at 17:10 UTC. perf looks good. no packet drops on our side.

dave_netops: verified firewall rules — had to open 443 -> 10.12.0.0/16 for metrics ingest. added change request CR-4821. FYI we've scheduled a follow-up firewall review next Tue.

anita_sec: KMS: key policy needs one small tweak — redwood-service-account needs "kms:Decrypt" for rotation lambda. I'll paste suggested policy diff.

anita_sec: ```diff
- "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-account" }
+ "Principal": { "AWS": [
+   "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service-account",
+   "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/rotation-lambda"
+ ] }
```

mike_cloudops: thanks @anita_sec — will push that as a minor patch today (non-disruptive).

leo_eng: audit logs: CloudWatch log group subscription to SIEM looks good but retention is 30d; customer wants 365d. opened ticket to extend retention and export to S3 bucket redwood-exports/ternion/ for long-term. ticket ID: SEC-715.

sara_cs: noted — please confirm S3 bucket encryption config and access policy before closing.

mike_cloudops: S3 bucket has SSE-KMS with customer-managed key (cmk-ternion). Need cross-account key grant for tenant ops IAM role — @anita_sec is that safe from a compliance POV?

anita_sec: yes, we need to add GrantPrincipal for arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/tenant-ops with condition aws:ViaAWSService if cross-account. I'll create CR with exact snippet.

dave_netops: small networking follow-up — NAT gateway in us-west-2 has elevated egress cost due to misrouted analytics traffic. We rerouted and put a rule to limit outgoing to known hosts. cost estimate change ~ +$120/mo.

sara_cs: ok flagging as renewal risk if costs trend. i'll include in the health report. anyone have action items for customer enablement? docs or runbook gaps?

leo_eng: runbook missing step for rekeying CMK after rotation; adding example CLI commands.

leo_eng: ```bash
aws kms create-key --description "ternion cmk - rotation" &&
aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id <id> --pending-window-in-days 30
```

sara_cs: fine. i'll send a brief "post-cutover summary + action list" to the customer today and ask for confirmation on retention/CMK grants. thanks all :raised_hands:
